designs.name: NVDLA nvdlav1
designs.license: NVIDIA Open NVDLA License and Agreement v1.0
designs.upstream_size: Full-precision nvdlav1 implements 2048 8-bit MACs or 1024 16-bit MACs, plus memories and control
designs.notes: Final frontend, hierarchy, memory, partition-capacity, and runtime stress test. NV_nvdla is the genuine connected top over the five upstream synthesis partitions. The shared frontend offers an explicitly labeled black-box SRAM scale screen and a separate fail-closed inferred-block-RAM model covering every pinned rws/rwsp/rwst/rwsthp wrapper for physical holdout validation; proprietary ASIC DFT logic is never expanded into LUTs. The nvdlav1 branch is deliberately pinned and its custom license must be preserved.
